Legend:

  X    = Self
  SYS  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the SMP interconnect between NUMA nodes (e.g., QPI/UPI)
  NODE = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the interconnect between PCIe Host Bridges within a NUMA node
  PHB  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as a PCIe Host Bridge (typically the CPU)
  PXB  = Connection traversing multiple PCIe bridges (without traversing the PCIe Host Bridge)
  PIX  = Connection traversing at most a single PCIe bridge
  NV#  = Connection traversing a bonded set of # NVLinks
warnings: GPU0: persistence mode disabled, so idle clocks drop to the lowest P-state. Any measurement without warmup times the clock ramp.
GPU1: persistence mode disabled, so idle clocks drop to the lowest P-state. Any measurement without warmup times the clock ramp.
GPU1: PCIe link negotiated x4 where the card supports x16. Host and peer transfers are link-limited.
GPUs sit on ASYMMETRIC PCIe links. Without NVLink, collective operations run at the slower card's rate: 0000:01:00.0 -> 0000:00:01.0 32.0 GT/s PCIex16; 0000:07:00.0 -> 0000:00:1d.0 16.0 GT/s PCIex4
Only 3447 MiB free on the tightest GPU: another workload is resident, so compute and bandwidth results are FLOORS, not peaks.

not_measured.reason: RT cores are only reachable through a ray-tracing API (OptiX, DXR or Vulkan RT). No compute or tensor path exercises them, so a CUDA benchmark cannot measure them at all. The core count is enumerated above.
not_measured.how_to_close: A dedicated OptiX or DXR trace-rate benchmark. Irrelevant to language-model inference, which is why it is enumerated rather than measured.

not_measured.reason: The runtime exposes weight-only INT4 (W4A16) but no dense INT4 GEMM, so the datasheet's INT4 tensor rate cannot be reproduced. The W4A16 figure above measures a different and, for inference, more relevant kernel.
not_measured.how_to_close: A cuBLASLt or CUTLASS INT4 GEMM path, if one is exposed by the runtime.

cases.prompt: What is 17 plus 26? Reply with the number only.
What is 12 times 12? Reply with the number only.
What is 100 minus 37? Reply with the number only.
What is half of 250? Reply with the number only.
How many days are in a week? Reply with the number only.
What is the capital city of France? Reply with one word.
What colour is the sky on a clear day? Reply with one word.
Complete: two, four, six, ____ . Reply with the number only.
Is 9 greater than 4? Answer yes or no.
Spell the word CAT in lowercase. Reply with one word.

method.determinism: identical output across repeats of the same prompt
method.exact_match: regex over the answer, single verifiable fact per case
method.note: This is a REGRESSION gate, not a capability benchmark. It detects a stack that has broken or been over-quantised; it says nothing about model quality.
